info.name: Telnyx Access Tokens Rooms Client Tokens API
Create Client Token to join a room.

params.name: room_id
params.description: The unique identifier of a room.

items.docs: Synchronously create an Client Token to join a Room. Client Token is necessary to join a Telnyx Room. Client Token will expire after `token_ttl_secs`, a Refresh Token is also provided to refresh a Client Token, the Refresh Token expires after `refresh_token_ttl_secs`.

info.name: Refresh Client Token to join a room.

params.name: room_id
params.description: The unique identifier of a room.

items.docs: Synchronously refresh an Client Token to join a Room. Client Token is necessary to join a Telnyx Room. Client Token will expire after `token_ttl_secs`.
